assumptions.construction: Compute placement-item demand beyond wreck stock and its production flow. Supplied machine catalog is not a timed startup sequence.
assumptions.heat: Conserve heat using resolved heat interfaces and runtime controller constants, at continuous duty with ideal delivery. Report temperature-class demands; geometry, sampled-duty aliasing and warmup require a runtime layout witness.
assumptions.labs: Size speed-1 pneumatic labs for the fastest supplied research cycle. Reserve full-load lab fuel in the flow; do not credit lab waste heat.
assumptions.objective: Minimize active process-machine seconds with all eligible alternative recipes and co-products.
assumptions.productivity: Native machine effects included. No modules, beacons, or technology productivity bonus.
assumptions.rates: Configured industrial comparison points, not an assertion of optimal player targets.
assumptions.raw: Local HCl extraction at declared 100 percent geyser yield. Extractor count and fuel are included; site availability and depletion are not a supplied map witness.
assumptions.solid_waste: Only listed solid residues may leave the model. Surplus rates are reported. Filled barrels cannot serve as fluid waste sinks. Fluid waste requires a real recipe.
assumptions.time: Base research supply bound at the configured simultaneous pack rates, not human construction time. Checkpoints are separate.
assumptions.uncertainty: Guaranteed outputs only, never expected probabilistic returns.

research_schedule.interpretation: Configured science lines and labs are online at time zero. Script checkpoints and research triggers are assumed satisfied when reached. No human construction time is inferred.
